reply.text:
Congratulations on the baby. When you can start running again is a question for your doctor or midwife, and your postpartum check-up is the right place to get that clearance. It depends on how your delivery and recovery went, which is not something a coach can judge.

Once they've cleared you, I'm glad to build a return-to-running plan that starts easy and builds gradually. Until then, tell me what you'd like help with on the training side, and I'll keep it within what they've said is okay.
